title: atelier.yaml
description: Atelier's configuration (ADR-0018). Kept in step with internal/config by a test.

listen.description: Address the HTTP server binds, host:port.

mainHost.description: Hostname for sign-in, the home page and the admin pages; no IP addresses.

sessionsHost.description: Hostname for sessions at /s/<id>/; a different hostname from mainHost, not just another port; no IP addresses (ADR-0016).

tls.description: Serve https with this certificate (covering both hosts) and key, PEM; reloaded when the files change.

certFile.description: Absolute path to the certificate chain.

keyFile.description: Absolute path to the private key; not readable by other accounts.

auth.description: Turn on at least one of pam and oidc.

pam.description: Sign in with host accounts through PAM (ADR-0017).

oidc.description: Sign in through an OpenID Connect provider.

clientSecret.description: A ${NAME} placeholder, read from the environment.

usernameClaim.description: Claim mapped to a host account.
